text: Overhead view of a square white plastic tray or open-topped enclosure with raised walls, sitting on a light grey work surface. The tray interior is empty apart from one small teal/green plastic block with four round studs on its upper face, resting flat near the centre. The floor of the tray shows eight recessed metal screw heads arranged around the middle, plus faint pink/red scuff marks and scratches. On the left outer wall are a piece of white tape near the top corner, a dark grey/black rectangular pad, and a black hexagonal piece. Small black tape markers lie on the surface along the bottom edge; another white part is partly visible at the right edge. No liquids or containers are visible.
